verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

translations.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created

verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab

translations.text: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
And from the evil of the blowers in knots

verses.transliteration: Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad

translations.text: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
